purpose: Blame absorption in one thing for neglecting another.
keywords: Absorbed in work, I neglected to contact my family.
I was so caught up in playing that I forgot my homework.
Preoccupied with immediate profit, they neglected safety.
restrictions: Usually followed by an omitted duty or unwelcome result.
mistake: It implies neglect, not simply being busy.
